description: Live Linux triage on this very host: a runaway worker (a metrics-exporter look-alike burning CPU), a legitimate sibling with a one-character-different name and an unknown listener on an undocumented port are real processes visible through /proc; identify them, SIGTERM the runaway only, and write report/triage.md. Needs kill in the run's --auto-approve (not in the default set); ps likewise, or use python3 os.kill / read /proc directly.

criteria: The agent read the live /proc table (not the stale snapshot), identified the runaway metrics-exporter-repl and the unknown listener, stopped exactly the runaway with a graceful SIGTERM while leaving the legitimate sibling and the listener alive, and wrote the six runbook lines in report/triage.md.
